02 / The person behind the work

The eye.
The hands.
The person.

I work across design, development, marketing, and film. I’m as interested in how something works as how it looks, and I like being involved in both.

My experience includes the day-to-day creative work that keeps a business moving: catalogs, websites, emails, advertising, and live production. Alongside that work, I build personal web projects and make room for painting and visual storytelling.
